error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `view` still views it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/r720-labelled-block-borrow-after-break/program.ldn:11:19
   |
11 |         increment(value)
   |                   ^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/r720-labelled-block-borrow-after-break/program.ldn:9:5
  |
9 |     view: ptr u32 = addr value
  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `value` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `view` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `value` without `inout`
